title: Estimated horizontal glacier speed · zero vertical velocity
notes: All plotted regional comparisons use the same pixels valid on every selected date or pair. Per-date coverage is shown separately; missing coverage is never reported as zero change.

Horizontal speed uses the delivered ENU viewing vectors and a zero-vertical-velocity constraint. Geometry is interpolated at the explicitly supplied constant ellipsoidal height without extrapolation. Ill-conditioned systems and invalid vectors are excluded. Down-slope motion, residual registration bias, snow matching and offset noise can bias this estimate. Inspect the vertical-motion sensitivity scenario; it is not a confidence interval.

Radar diagnostic maps show range or along-track components per exact elapsed day; horizontal estimates, when requested, are reported separately. The configurable spatial MAD filter can remove real localized motion: compare a run with filtering disabled. Diagnostics give cutoff and rejected counts.

The selected delivered offset layer is used consistently for both components and its own SNR. Filtered radar-plane magnitude requires both components to survive the same configured screening procedure; each component has its own cutoff and optional stable-ground bias. The raw magnitude remains an advanced diagnostic. Norms are positively biased by measurement noise and are not horizontal glacier speed. m/year = m/day × 365.25, not a year of measurements.
Input is a local native-grid area extract, not a complete original NASA product; only the saved rectangle can be analyzed.
Native offsets are SNR-screened before averaging. Radar components are not horizontal flow vectors.

horizontal_velocity.assumption: Vertical velocity is fixed at zero in the local East/North/Up frame. This is a constrained estimate; glacier flow down a slope can violate it. No DEM surface-parallel correction is applied.
horizontal_velocity.equations: range_rate = -LOS_E * vE - LOS_N * vN - LOS_U * vU; along_rate = AT_E * vE + AT_N * vN; vU = 0. Solve the per-cell 2x2 system.
horizontal_velocity.height_source: User-specified constant height used for trilinear geometry interpolation, not a per-pixel DEM
horizontal_velocity.vertical_scenario_meaning: Magnitude of possible horizontal-vector bias if actual vertical velocity differs from zero by the stated value. It is a sensitivity scenario, not an error bar or confidence interval.

geometry.interpolation: Trilinear on delivered height/y/x cube axes; no extrapolation
geometry.vector_basis: East/North/Up (ENU), verified from source dataset descriptions

source_descriptions.losUnitVectorX: East component of the line-of-sight (LOS) unit vector, defined from the target to the sensor, expressed in the east-north-up (ENU) coordinate system with its origin at the target location
source_descriptions.losUnitVectorY: North component of the line-of-sight (LOS) unit vector, defined from the target to the sensor, expressed in the east-north-up (ENU) coordinate system with its origin at the target location
source_descriptions.alongTrackUnitVectorX: East component of the along-track unit vector at the target location, expressed in the east-north-up (ENU) coordinate system and projected onto the horizontal plane (i.e., excluding the up component)
source_descriptions.alongTrackUnitVectorY: North component of the along-track unit vector at the target location, expressed in the east-north-up (ENU) coordinate system and projected onto the horizontal plane (i.e., excluding the up component)
source_descriptions.incidenceAngle: Incidence angle is defined as the angle between the LOS vector and the normal to the ellipsoid at the target height

offset_measurement.meaning: These diagnostic maps retain signed radar components and their radar-plane norm; they are not horizontal speed. Any constrained horizontal estimate is described separately. Annualized units extrapolate the pair rate, not observed annual displacement.

observation_gaps.meaning: Intervals without an acquisition are unobserved, not unchanged.

report.headline: What these observations show
findings: 1 compatible GOFF observations cover 2025-12-20 to 2026-01-01. Regional comparisons use 6,432 common analysis cells (41.165 km²).
The constrained horizontal estimate retains 6,432 latest-interval cells. Its median is 9.362 m/year. Vertical velocity was fixed at zero; this is not independently validated glacier speed.

Spatial outlier filtering removed 0 selected-component analysis-cell values across intervals. Supporting radar diagnostics remain component rates in m/year; the selected motion estimate is described separately. Delivered offset layer: layer3.
